verdict.rationale: Parts of the Isaac platform are documented as open source: Isaac Lab is described as an open-source framework, and the community notes that Isaac GR00T N1 was released under Apache 2. Isaac Sim has a public GitHub repo and docs on building your own wheels from local modifications, but no license is stated for Isaac Sim or Isaac ROS, so openness across the whole platform is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit open license for Isaac Sim and Isaac ROS, first-party license documentation, independent corroboration of source availability across all components.
